pillar_diversity.justification: Spans all five pillars only nominally; the AOV and Retention experiments are variations on the same access barrier rather than distinct content levers.

specificity_vs_slop.justification: Specific to gingerpeople's actual Cloudflare block and ginger category, but lacks store-content specificity because nothing was crawlable.

competitor_quality.justification: Real ginger competitors with adaptable patterns, but store_edge is assessed externally since the storefront is uncrawlable.

technical_rigor.justification: Technical checks are strongly grounded in the observed 403 evidence and correctly mark Fail vs Warn.
